purpose.zh: 练腰腹稳定，让一只手和另一侧的腿配合
purpose.en: Build trunk stability and get one arm and the opposite leg working together.

text.zh: 一只手和另一侧的腿伸远，身体不晃
text.en: Reach one arm and the other leg long while your body stays still

text.zh: 跪撑，手在肩膀下面，膝盖在髋下面。
text.en: Start on hands and knees, hands under shoulders, knees under hips.

text.zh: 腿伸到髋那么高，手到肩那么高，停住再收回。
text.en: Reach the leg to hip height and the arm to shoulder height, hold, then return.

commonErrors.en: Letting your lower back sag or your hips twist.

cautions.zh: 腰疼时伸得近一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your lower back hurts, reach less far, and stop if it still hurts.
